Get Started

For Product Manufacturers

Your Products, Smarter

3D product configurators, BIM integration, and AI powered consulting assistants that help your customers find, specify, and order the right product in seconds.

Get Started

Digital tools that make your products easier to find, specify, and buy.

Interactive 3D configurators that let engineers and architects explore, customize, and specify your products without waiting for a sales call. Customers select dimensions, materials, and options visually and receive technical specifications and pricing on the spot.

  • Real time 3D visualization of all product variants
  • Automatic generation of specification documents and datasheets
  • Embedded directly into your website with no separate login required

BIM objects and plugin integrations that place your products directly inside the design tools your customers already use every day. When an engineer drags your product into their Revit or Archicad model, you have already won the specification.

  • Native BIM objects for Revit, Archicad, Allplan, and Tekla
  • Parametric families that update automatically with your product data
  • Download tracking that shows you who specifies your products

An AI powered product assistant trained on your technical documentation that answers customer questions instantly. It recommends the right product variant, checks compatibility, and generates specification documents without involving your sales team.

  • Trained exclusively on your product data and technical documentation
  • Handles product selection, compatibility checks, and specification generation
  • Available around the clock on your website with no wait time for customers

Every interaction with your digital tools generates data. Which products get configured most? Where do users drop off? Which BIM objects get downloaded in which markets? We turn this data into actionable insights that inform your product strategy and sales priorities.

  • Configuration completion rates and drop off analysis
  • BIM download tracking by region, firm type, and project stage
  • AI assistant conversation analytics and frequently asked questions

Built for manufacturers who sell through specifications, not just catalogs.

If you have further questions, please reach out via our Contact page.

Contact us
How long does it take to build a 3D configurator?

It depends on the complexity of your product range. A single product line with clear options can be live in 6 to 8 weeks. More complex portfolios with interdependencies between dimensions, materials, and accessories take 10 to 14 weeks. We always start with your highest volume products first.

Do we need to maintain the BIM objects ourselves?

No. The BIM objects are connected to your product data. When you update a product specification, the BIM objects update automatically. There is no manual file management or version control on your side.

How is the AI assistant trained?

We train it exclusively on your technical documentation, product catalogs, installation guides, and FAQs. It does not use generic construction knowledge. Before it goes live, your technical team reviews and approves the responses to make sure they are accurate.

Can the configurator connect to our ERP or pricing system?

Yes. We build integrations with common ERP systems so the configurator can pull live pricing, stock availability, and lead times. Customers see real data, not outdated catalog prices.

What if a customer configures something that is not producible?

The configurator enforces your production rules in real time. Invalid combinations are blocked before the customer can submit them. This means your sales team only receives valid, producible configurations.

How do we measure the impact?

We provide dashboards that track configuration completions, BIM downloads, AI assistant interactions, and specification document generation. You can see exactly how many specifications your digital tools generate compared to traditional channels.

Put your products at the point of decision.

Construction product manufacturers compete on more than just quality. The firms that win specifications are the ones whose products are easiest to find, configure, and integrate into a project. We build the digital tools that put your products at the point of decision.

Why partner with GSI Labs?

Practical Innovation

We do not build generic product configurators or off the shelf BIM libraries. Every tool is built around your specific product logic, your data structure, and your customers' workflows.

The configurator enforces your production rules. The BIM objects match your real specifications. The AI assistant speaks your technical language. Everything works because it was built for your products, not adapted from a template.

Strategic Edge

While your competitors still rely on PDF catalogs and email based inquiries, your customers configure, specify, and download your products in minutes.

That means more specifications, shorter sales cycles, and a digital presence that works around the clock without adding headcount. Over time, this compounds into a measurable competitive advantage in specification driven markets.

Industry DNA

Our team includes construction product specialists, BIM developers, and AI engineers who understand how specifications happen in the AEC industry. We know the difference between a Revit family and an Archicad object.

We understand what a specifier needs at the point of decision. That means no long onboarding, no explaining your market. We start building on day one.
